mapper.sql: select t.*, c.name city_name, c.province_id, p.name province_name, p.country_id, co.name country_name from voya_ai_attraction t left join voya_ai_city c on c.id = t.city_id left join voya_ai_province p on p.id = c.province_id left join voya_ai_country co on co.id = p.country_id
mapper.select: select * from voya_ai_attraction where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_attraction where city_id = #{cityId} and name = #{name} and id != #{id}

select (select count(*) from voya_ai_trip_item where attraction_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0') + (select count(*) from voya_ai_favorite where target_type = 'attraction' and target_id = #{id}) + (select count(*) from voya_ai_like where target_type = 'attraction' and target_id = #{id}) + (select count(*) from voya_ai_comment where target_type = 'attraction' and target_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0')
mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_attraction (city_id, name, cover_image, description, address, latitude, longitude, ticket_price, opening_hours, recommended_duration, rating, sort, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values (#{cityId}, #{name}, #{coverImage}, #{description}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{ticketPrice}, #{openingHours}, #{recommendedDuration}, #{rating}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), '0')
mapper.update: update voya_ai_attraction set city_id = #{cityId}, name = #{name}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, description = #{description}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, ticket_price = #{ticketPrice}, opening_hours = #{openingHours}, recommended_duration = #{recommendedDuration}, rating = #{rating}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_attraction set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_attraction set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{username}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select image_url from voya_ai_attraction_image where attraction_id = #{id} order by sort, id
mapper.insert:
insert into voya_ai_attraction_image (attraction_id, image_url, sort) values
(#{id}, #{image}, #{position})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.name, case when c.status = '0' and p.status = '0' and co.status = '0' then '0' else '1' end as status from voya_ai_city c join voya_ai_province p on p.id = c.province_id and p.del_flag = '0' join voya_ai_country co on co.id = p.country_id and co.del_flag = '0' where c.del_flag = '0' and c.province_id = #{provinceId} order by c.sort desc, c.id desc
